title: Maaaagic²
author: tigran
rules:
Hello everyone! The magic square dynamic is something I’m really fond of, and this is my second take on incorporating magic squares into sudoku. I hope you enjoy it:)

Rules

Normal sudoku rules apply.

Antiking: Cells a chess king’s move apart cannot contain the same digit.

Antiknight: Cells a chess knight’s move apart cannot contain the same digit.

Killer cages: The digits in a cage sum to the number in the cage’s top-left corner. Digits cannot repeat within a cage.

Magic square: The center 3x3 box (box 5) is a magic square. In a magic square, every row, every column and both main diagonals of the box have the same sum.

Solve in SudokuPad

Hint (highlight the box below to see):

The intended start is deducing which digits can go in the magic square’s corners, edges and center.
